title: Fix views increment option not working in VideoPlayer

requirements.summary: Fix the view count increment feature in the VideoPlayer page so that view counts are correctly incremented when a user watches a video
acceptanceCriteria: After a user watches at least 5 seconds of a video, the view count increments by 1
The increment is called only once per viewing session (no duplicate calls on re-render)
The updated view count is visible on the VideoPlayer page after the increment
The useIncrementVideoView mutation is invoked and the related video queries are invalidated on success

file_operations.description: Fix the view increment logic to ensure it fires exactly once per viewing session after 5 seconds of actual watch time. Review the current implementation that tracks playback time and calls useIncrementVideoView. Ensure the increment is triggered using a ref-based flag to prevent duplicate calls on re-render, and that the mutation is invoked with proper error handling. Verify the logic accounts for pauses and only counts actual playback time. After the increment succeeds, ensure the updated view count is reflected in the UI by relying on the mutation's query invalidation.
